links.comparator_used: Conventional 2D manual segmentation for liver volumetry (not fully automatic AI without human correction)
links.outcome: Turnaround time and accuracy of graft volume prediction against intraoperative graft weight
links.effect: Turnaround 1.5 ± 1.5 vs 4.2 ± 3.6 days (p < 0.001). After exclusions, R2 0.818 and median error 54.0 mL with AI-based volumetry vs R2 0.707 and median error 65.0 mL with conventional methods. AI and manually edited volumes agreed with R2 = 0.992 and a mean difference of 23.7 ± 39.5 mL.
links.quote: The AI group had shorter turnaround times (1.5 ± 1.5 vs. 4.2 ± 3.6 days; p < 0.001).

design_hint: clinician manual refinement of AI segmentation output
